title: Protocol for Trapping Transient Endogenous Formaldehyde in Live Cells
author: Pan, Liang, et al.
materials:
•Trami probe stock solution: Dissolve an appropriate amount of Trami probe with DMSO to 5 mM.•Trami probe working solution: Dilute the stock solution with serum-free DMEM medium to 5 μM.
Note: The probe stock solution is stored at −20°C for short-term storage up to 6 months. Avoid repeat freeze/thaw cycles. The working solution should be prepared fresh during the procedure. For inexperienced experimenters, an additional critical detail is to store the stock solution in the dark at all times (e.g., using amber glass vials or wrapping containers in aluminum foil) to prevent light-induced degradation, as many probes are photosensitive. When preparing working solutions, these must be made fresh immediately before use during the experimental procedure. Ensure working solutions are also protected from light until they are added to samples, to preserve their integrity.

steps.title: Prepare Trami probe solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve Trami probe in DMSO to make a 5 mM stock solution; store the stock at –20 °C in the dark (amber vial or foil) for up to 6 months, avoiding freeze‑thaw cycles. Immediately before use, dilute the stock with serum‑free DMEM to a 5 µM working solution, keep the working solution protected from light and prepare it fresh.

steps.title: Stain cells with Trami probe
steps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium and wash the cells three times with pre‑warmed (37 °C) serum‑free DMEM. Add 1 mL per well of 5 µM Trami probe in serum‑free DMEM and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min in the dark. Aspirate the probe‑containing medium and wash the cells three rapid times with pre‑heated PBS (pH 7.4). Add 1 mL per well of serum‑free DMEM and incubate for 1 h in a 5 % CO₂, 37 °C atmosphere to allow probe reaction and protein labeling; protect from light throughout.

steps.title: Permeabilize cell membranes
steps.instruction: Treat each well with 1 mL of 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in TBS and incubate at 25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells in TBST containing 10 % goat serum and 0.1 % Triton X‑100 (1 mL per well) at ambient temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute antibodies in the blocking buffer: anti‑CD16 (rabbit monoclonal) 1:400 and β‑tubulin (mouse monoclonal) 1:2000. Add 500 µL per well and incubate for 12 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and incubate secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with ice‑cold PBS (5 min per wash at ambient temperature). Prepare secondary antibodies in blocking buffer (3 % BSA in PBS with 0.1 % Tween‑20): Fluor 594 anti‑mouse IgG 1:200 (for β‑tubulin, red channel) and Fluor 488 anti‑rabbit IgG 1:200 (for CD16, green channel). Add the appropriate secondary antibody (volume not specified, use same 500 µL per well) and incubate for 1 h at ambient temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Mount and cure samples
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS (5 min per wash at ambient temperature). Mount coverslips with ProLong Gold Antifade Mountant (non‑fluorescent formula), seal with nail polish, and cure at ambient temperature for 24 h in the dark. Store slides at 4 °C protected from light and use within 1 week.
